method: v0.5.7 repair compatibility recertification. The exact successful v0.5.6 Alex Lab artifact and the current v0.5.7 repair artifact were compared by packet_id: all 384 packet identities are unchanged; 262 packets are byte-identical and 122 differ only in available_tools, with prompt, visible history, actor, source and conversation type unchanged. GPT-5.6 Sol reviewed those 122 changed tool surfaces. Every prior selected tool remains available. Four packets where the deterministic oracle selected a different valid route were manually re-reviewed and the prior snapshot decisions were retained: original recordings -> find_media; pending expense approval -> list_pending_expenses + confirm_expense; warranty query -> warranty_expiring; saved pictures -> search_saved_items. No decision changes were required. The fingerprint now binds the snapshot to the exact current 384-packet corpus.
